name: Family Tree
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My brother Nataka is stationed at Ghost Walker Post over in Desolace. I'd like to ask you... could you give this report to him for me? A year has passed since the last time I wrote, there has been unusual centaur activity since then and he should be informed.

Journey to Stonetalon Mountain north of the Crossroads, and then head west into Charred Vale. From there, head south into Desolace; there you will find a road going south to Ghost Walker Post.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I know not what connection you have with my brother but it would seem he has trust with you, Champion.

I am Nataka Longhorn and would like to welcome you to Ghost Walker Post, we have many needs of a Champion! Talk with others, perhaps there is need of you here.
narrative.requestItemsText: What news have you, Champion! Ah - a message from my brother you say? Well then, hand over the report!
